text_block_list.text:
And so, my first three years with Kiseki 
came to an end.
However—

Kiseki's story won't end in just three 
short years.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the strongest Umamusume has 
appeared in the 'Japan Cup' paddock once 
again!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The race favorite is none other than this 
Umamusume, the 8-time GⅠ winner, Almond 
Eye!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Their opponent is, of course, this 
Umamusume! It's Kiseki!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've come to keep my promise. 
Ai-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If we're going to write the next chapter 
of that day, then of course I have to take 
the win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't yield. I'm the one who will 
win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I've been looking forward to this rematch 
more than anyone else!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —! Fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Bring it. Come at me head-on, Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The one who defeats you will be— none 
other than the miracle of a protagonist!!
A certain person says this:
'Uma Musume'…… They were born to run.

Born with the names of another world, 
carrying histories sometimes bizarre, 
sometimes glorious, they inherit those 
souls and run... That is their destiny.
And—

"—No one knows the future race results of 
the Umamusume living in this world just 
yet!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —So, watch me.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Our story begins anew from here.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A new "story" that we will spin together!
